/* Theme switcher */
.theme-picker{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.theme-picker select{width:auto;min-height:34px;margin:0;padding:6px 28px 6px 9px;border-radius:999px}
.compact-btn{padding:6px 10px;font-size:12px}

/* War room */
:root[data-theme="warroom"]{
  --bg:#050b14;--bg2:#081421;--panel:#0b1725;--panel2:#102238;--panel3:#07111d;
  --line:#1f4568;--text:#edf7ff;--muted:#7fa5c8;--accent:#23a6ff;--accent2:#1576bd;
  --good:#25d07f;--warn:#f4b740;--bad:#ff5e67;--shadow:0 16px 42px rgba(0,20,40,.34)
}
:root[data-theme="warroom"] body{background:
  radial-gradient(circle at 80% 0%,rgba(35,166,255,.08),transparent 30%),
  linear-gradient(180deg,#040a12,#07111d 55%,#050b14)}
:root[data-theme="warroom"] .app-header h1{letter-spacing:.02em}
:root[data-theme="warroom"] .sidebar{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(35,166,255,.03),var(--shadow)}
:root[data-theme="warroom"] .hero-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0d2236,#0b3150)}
:root[data-theme="warroom"] .version,
:root[data-theme="warroom"] .status-chip,
:root[data-theme="warroom"] .chips span{background:#082b48;border-color:#1d5b8d;color:#d6f0ff}
:root[data-theme="warroom"] .nav-btn.active{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0d3761,#133154);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 #2bb2ff}

/* Police information system */
:root[data-theme="police"]{
  --bg:#edf2f7;--bg2:#f4f7fa;--panel:#ffffff;--panel2:#eef4fa;--panel3:#f8fafc;
  --line:#cbd6e2;--text:#17263a;--muted:#63758a;--accent:#174f8a;--accent2:#123e6b;
  --good:#1f7a4d;--warn:#a66b0a;--bad:#b73b45;--shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(41,62,85,.09)
}
:root[data-theme="police"] body{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#edf2f7,#f7f9fb)}
:root[data-theme="police"] .sidebar,
:root[data-theme="police"] .panel,
:root[data-theme="police"] .hero-card,
:root[data-theme="police"] .stat-card{background:#fff}
:root[data-theme="police"] .profile-mini{background:#eaf1f8}
:root[data-theme="police"] .avatar{background:#dbe9f6;border-color:#aac2d9;color:#153f69}
:root[data-theme="police"] .nav-btn.active{background:#dbe9f7;color:#143c65;box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 #174f8a}
:root[data-theme="police"] input,
:root[data-theme="police"] select,
:root[data-theme="police"] .dispatch-box,
:root[data-theme="police"] .choice-card,
:root[data-theme="police"] .county-card,
:root[data-theme="police"] .action-card,
:root[data-theme="police"] .exam-summary>div,
:root[data-theme="police"] .career-node{background:#f7fafc;color:var(--text)}
:root[data-theme="police"] .hero-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f8fbff,#e9f2fb)}
:root[data-theme="police"] .version,
:root[data-theme="police"] .status-chip,
:root[data-theme="police"] .chips span{background:#e5eef8;border-color:#b9cde0;color:#20476f}
:root[data-theme="police"] .muted,
:root[data-theme="police"] .panel-head span,
:root[data-theme="police"] .choice-card p,
:root[data-theme="police"] .county-card p,
:root[data-theme="police"] .action-card p{color:#63758a}

/* Game UI */
:root[data-theme="game"]{
  --bg:#11131b;--bg2:#191d2b;--panel:#1b2030;--panel2:#252c42;--panel3:#151a27;
  --line:#3a4460;--text:#fff7e8;--muted:#b7b2a5;--accent:#f08a34;--accent2:#cc6b20;
  --good:#64c878;--warn:#f2c14e;--bad:#e86161;--shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.28)
}
:root[data-theme="game"] body{background:
  radial-gradient(circle at 12% 0%,rgba(240,138,52,.1),transparent 25%),
  linear-gradient(180deg,#11131b,#171b28)}
:root[data-theme="game"] .panel,
:root[data-theme="game"] .stat-card,
:root[data-theme="game"] .sidebar{border-width:2px}
:root[data-theme="game"] .nav-btn.active{background:#48301f;color:#ffd9b8;box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 #f08a34}
:root[data-theme="game"] .hero-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2b2530,#45301f)}
:root[data-theme="game"] .version,
:root[data-theme="game"] .status-chip,
:root[data-theme="game"] .chips span{background:#3c2b1f;border-color:#76502f;color:#ffe2c4}
:root[data-theme="game"] .primary-btn{box-shadow:0 4px 0 #8b4817}
:root[data-theme="game"] .choice-card:hover,
:root[data-theme="game"] .county-card:hover,
:root[data-theme="game"] .action-card:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}


/* v3 institution model */
.duty-mode-panel{margin-bottom:14px}
#careerPath{margin-top:0}
#careerPath .career-node{font-size:13px}
#promotionScoreBox{margin:10px 0 12px}
#dashQualification,#dashOfficialRank,#dashSequence{color:var(--text)}
@media(max-width:620px){
  #careerPath{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr}
  #careerPath .career-arrow{transform:rotate(90deg);text-align:center}
}


/* v4 sequence-based career UI */
.sequence-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:12px;
  margin:14px 0;
}
.sequence-card{
  background:var(--panel);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:16px;
  padding:14px 16px;
}
.sequence-card.current{
  border-color:var(--accent);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent);
}
.sequence-card.passed{opacity:.62}
.sequence-card .seq-head{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;
  align-items:flex-start;
  margin-bottom:8px;
}
.sequence-card .seq-head span{
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:12px;
  text-align:right;
}
.sequence-card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.65}
.sequence-rank-reference{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:2px 0 9px}
.sequence-rank-reference .rank-insignia-label{font-size:12px}
.sequence-note{margin:10px 0 4px}
.sequence-card em{
  display:inline-block;
  margin-top:10px;
  font-style:normal;
  font-size:12px;
  color:var(--accent);
}
.promotion-target-label{
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:6px;
  margin:12px 0;
}
.promotion-target-label select{width:100%}
@media(max-width:720px){
  .sequence-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .sequence-card .seq-head{flex-direction:column}
  .sequence-card .seq-head span{text-align:left}
}


/* v5 officer rotation */
#unit .choice-card b{color:var(--text)}
#unit .info-banner{line-height:1.7}


/* v6 Taipei-only scope */
#distribution .county-card h3{margin-bottom:6px}
#distribution .county-card p{min-height:44px}


/* v3.3 station detail */
.station-directory-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:10px;
}
.station-directory-item{
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:6px;
  padding:12px 14px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:14px;
  background:var(--panel3);
}
.station-directory-item b{font-size:14px}
.station-directory-item span{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.55}
.station-note{margin:12px 0 0}
@media(max-width:720px){
  .station-directory-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}


/* v3.5 audit and precinct organization */
#precinctOrgDirectory{margin-bottom:14px}
.station-directory-item.current{
  border-color:var(--accent);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent);
}
.station-directory-item em{
  font-style:normal;
  font-size:11px;
  color:var(--accent);
}
#selfCheckResult.good{border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.45)}
#selfCheckResult.bad{border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.45)}


/* v3.8 vacancy forecast */
.vacancy-forecast{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:14px;
  align-items:center;
  margin:10px 0 14px;
  padding:11px 14px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:13px;
  background:var(--panel3);
}
.vacancy-forecast span{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.vacancy-forecast b{text-align:right;font-size:13px}
.exam-summary .wide{grid-column:1/-1}
@media(max-width:720px){
  .vacancy-forecast{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}
  .vacancy-forecast b{text-align:left}
}


/* v3.9 progressive exam action */
.exam-action-hint{
  margin:14px 0 10px;
  padding:10px 12px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:12px;
  background:var(--panel3);
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:13px;
}
.exam-progress-actions button{
  min-width:220px;
}
.exam-progress-actions .primary-btn{
  animation:examPulse 1.5s ease-in-out 1;
}
@keyframes examPulse{
  0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}
  50%{transform:scale(1.025)}
}
@media(max-width:600px){
  .exam-progress-actions button{width:100%;min-width:0}
}


/* v4.0 police rank insignia */
.rank-chip-visual{
  display:inline-flex!important;
  align-items:center;
  gap:7px;
}
.rank-insignia-wrap{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:flex-end;
  gap:10px;
}
.rank-insignia{
  position:relative;
  display:inline-flex;
  min-width:118px;
  height:38px;
  padding:3px 8px;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  overflow:hidden;
  border:2px solid #d9b700;
  border-radius:4px;
  background:#080808;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,230,0,.22);
}
.rank-insignia.compact{
  min-width:74px;
  height:25px;
  border-width:1px;
  padding:2px 5px;
}
.insignia-lines{
  position:absolute;
  inset:4px 5px;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  justify-content:space-evenly;
  z-index:1;

<dialog id="workforceScenarioDialog" class="topic-quiz-dialog wf-dialog" aria-labelledby="workforceScenarioTitle">
  <div class="wf-head">
    <div><span class="eyebrow" id="workforceScenarioRole">案件情境演練</span><h2 id="workforceScenarioTitle">案件人力配置</h2></div>
    <button type="button" class="secondary-btn" id="workforceScenarioClose" aria-label="關閉情境演練">關閉</button>
  </div>
  <div class="wf-body">
    <div class="wf-case"><span class="wf-case-number" id="workforceCaseNumber"></span><h3 id="workforceCaseTitle" tabindex="-1"></h3><p id="workforceCaseStory"></p><ul id="workforceCaseFacts"></ul></div>
    <p class="wf-mode-note" id="workforceModeNote"></p>
    <form id="workforceScenarioForm">
      <fieldset class="wf-priority"><legend>1 · 先做哪件事？</legend><div id="workforcePriorityChoices"></div></fieldset>
      <section class="wf-allocation" aria-labelledby="workforceAllocationTitle">
        <h3 id="workforceAllocationTitle">2 · 配置人力與分工</h3>
        <div id="workforceResources" class="wf-resources"></div>
        <div id="workforceSupportControl"></div>
        <p id="workforceBudget" class="wf-budget" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
        <div id="workforceTaskControls" class="wf-tasks"></div>
      </section>
      <fieldset class="wf-coordination"><legend>3 · 通報與協作</legend><label><input type="checkbox" id="workforceNotify"><span id="workforceNotifyText">回報勤務指揮中心，說明現況、分工與支援需求</span></label><label id="workforceMedicalLabel"><input type="checkbox" id="workforceMedical">聯繫消防／救護，交代傷者及現場狀況</label></fieldset>
      <div class="wf-actions"><button type="submit" class="primary-btn" id="workforceSubmit">送出並分析配置</button><button type="button" class="secondary-btn" id="workforceNext" hidden>下一件情境</button></div>
    </form>
    <p id="workforceScenarioStatus" class="wf-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
    <section id="workforceAnalysis" class="wf-analysis" hidden aria-label="配置分析" tabindex="-1"></section>
    <label class="wf-auto"><input type="checkbox" id="workforceAutoNext" checked>分析後 6 秒自動換案（可關閉）</label>
    <details class="wf-sources"><summary>情境設定與官方參考資料</summary><p>案件、工作量、人數及評分為遊戲情境設定，各工作假設同時進行、每人只分配一項；可有多種可行配置。官方資料用於通報、協調與安全原則，人數不是官方固定編制。</p><div id="workforceSourceLinks"></div></details>
  </div>
</dialog>
